request: Six individual transparent inventory item illustrations for Wreckabulary Unity
artDirection: Isolated square tactile toy-like 3D inventory items; bold silhouettes; warm cream, gold, teal and red; coherent warm overhead-left softbox lighting; no typography, logos or cards.

validation.method: Visual inspection of all six native generated outputs plus read-only System.Drawing RGBA sample checks and SHA-256 of workspace copies.
validation.nativeUnityImport: Not run by art lane; parent owns import, consumption and in-engine verification.
validation.postprocessing: None. Original built-in PNG bytes copied into project; source outputs retained.
validation.alphaNote: Every PNG has genuine transparent pixels. Solid object samples are mostly alpha 252–253/255 from native generation, with softer partial-alpha ability effects; preserved verbatim.
